description: Assign one or more Okta users to an Okta group using user ID, list of IDs, login, or email.
command:
GROUP_ARG="${answer1}"
GROUP_ID=$(echo "$GROUP_ARG" | tr -d " 	
\"'[]")

if [[ ! "$GROUP_ID" =~ ^00g ]] || [ ${#GROUP_ID} -lt 15 ]; then
  RESOLVED_GID=$(curl -sS -G "$OKTA_URL/api/v1/groups" \
    -H "Accept: application/json" \
    -H "Authorization: SSWS $OKTA_API_TOKEN" \
    --data-urlencode "q=$GROUP_ARG" | python3 -c '
import sys, json
try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
    name = """""".strip().lower()
    match = next((g for g in d if g.get("profile", {}).get("name", "").strip().lower() == name), d[0] if d else None)
    print(match["id"] if match else "")
except:
    print("")
')
  [ -n "$RESOLVED_GID" ] && GROUP_ID="$RESOLVED_GID"
fi

RAW_USERS="${answer2}"
UIDS=$(echo "$RAW_USERS" | grep -oE "00u[a-zA-Z0-9]+")

if [ -z "$UIDS" ]; then
  TOKENS=$(echo "$RAW_USERS" | tr ",;[]\"'" "\n")
  for tok in $TOKENS; do
    tok=$(echo "$tok" | tr -d " 	
")
    [ -z "$tok" ] && continue
    if [[ "$tok" =~ ^00u ]]; then
      UIDS="$UIDS $tok"
    else
      LOOKUP=$(curl -sS -G "$OKTA_URL/api/v1/users" \
        -H "Accept: application/json" \
        -H "Authorization: SSWS $OKTA_API_TOKEN" \
        --data-urlencode "q=$tok" | python3 -c '
import sys, json
try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
    print(d[0]["id"] if isinstance(d, list) and d else "")
except:
    print("")
')
      [ -n "$LOOKUP" ] && UIDS="$UIDS $LOOKUP"
    fi
  done
fi

COUNT=0
ASSIGNED=()
for uid in $UIDS; do
  [ -z "$uid" ] && continue
  RES=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X PUT \
    -H "Accept: application/json" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Authorization: SSWS $OKTA_API_TOKEN" \
    "$OKTA_URL/api/v1/groups/$GROUP_ID/users/$uid")
  if [ "$RES" = "204" ] || [ "$RES" = "200" ]; then
    ASSIGNED+=("$uid")
    COUNT=$((COUNT + 1))
    echo "  • Assigned $uid to group $GROUP_ID"
  else
    echo "  • Failed $uid (HTTP $RES)"
  fi
done

echo "Assigned $COUNT user(s) to group $GROUP_ID."
python3 -c '
import sys, json
group_id = sys.argv[1]
count = int(sys.argv[2])
users = sys.argv[3:]
print(json.dumps({
    "status": "success" if count > 0 else "error",
    "group_id": group_id,
    "assigned_count": count,
    "user_ids": users
}))
' "$GROUP_ID" "$COUNT" "${ASSIGNED[@]}"
questions: What is the ID of the Okta group? (If a group was just created or selected, answer with exactly '${Create Okta Group.id}' or '${Select Group By Name.id}'. Otherwise, provide the actual ID)*
What is the email or ID of the user to assign? (If a user was just created, answer with exactly '${Create Okta User.id}'. Otherwise, provide the email or ID)*
